    Exclusion of contours #

    A large indecomposable over a connected representation-finite convex piece of the cover cannot exist if the ray category has a branching morphism (false_of_branch).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.exists_lift_mod {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] {x₀ : P} {S : Finset (Cover x₀)} {k : Type u} [Field k] (ℓ : (y : P) → vtx x₀ ⟶ vtx y) (htf : Graded.TorsionFree (Cover.Pi1 x₀)) (hpar : ParEq S) (hS : Cover.Convex ↑S) {x y : P} {w : x ⟶ y} (hbr : IsBranch w) {K : ℕ} (hK : ∀ (Z : AR.FDMod k (RayQuiver.Linearization P k)), AR.IsIndecMod (RayQuiver.Linearization P k) Z.carrier → Nontrivial Z.carrier → (∀ (m : Z.carrier), RayQuiver.morElt k w • m = 0) → Module.finrank k Z.carrier ≤ K) (N : AR.FDMod k (PieceAlg k S)) (hN : AR.IndNT N) (hlt : K < Module.finrank k N.carrier) :
    ∃ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V) (j : (pieceQuiver S).V), ⟨(pt S i).y, ⟨(pt S j).y, Cover.val (gval i j)⟩⟩ = ⟨x, ⟨y, w⟩⟩ ∧ PR i j ∧ ∃ (n : N.carrier), cv k i j • n ≠ 0

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.false_of_branch {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] {x₀ : P} {S : Finset (Cover x₀)} {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (ℓ : (y : P) → vtx x₀ ⟶ vtx y) (htf : Graded.TorsionFree (Cover.Pi1 x₀)) (hS : Cover.Convex ↑S) (hne : S.Nonempty) (hacycCov : CoverAcyclic x₀) (hint : ∀ (a b : Cover x₀), (interval a b).Finite) (hlsc : CoverLocalSC x₀) (hconnS : ∀ (T : Set (pieceQuiver S).V), T.Nonempty → (∀ (α : (pieceQuiver S).A), (pieceQuiver S).src α ∈ T ↔ (pieceQuiver S).tgt α ∈ T) → T = Set.univ) (hrep : PieceRepFin k S) {x y : P} {w : x ⟶ y} (hbr : IsBranch w) {K M : ℕ} (hK : ∀ (Z : AR.FDMod k (RayQuiver.Linearization P k)), AR.IsIndecMod (RayQuiver.Linearization P k) Z.carrier → Nontrivial Z.carrier → (∀ (m : Z.carrier), RayQuiver.morElt k w • m = 0) → Module.finrank k Z.carrier ≤ K) (hM : ∀ (x y : P) (l : List (RayQuiver.quiver P).A) (h : FinQuiver.PathFrom x l y), RayQuiver.pathMor l x y h ≠ 0 → l.length < M) (N : AR.FDMod k (PieceAlg k S)) (hN : AR.IndNT N) (hlt : K < Module.finrank k N.carrier) (hlarge : morCard P * (2 * morCard P + 1) ^ (2 * M + (K + 1) + 1) < Nat.card ↑((pieceDirData ⋯).Supp N)) :

    A branching morphism bounds indecomposables.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.exists_div {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] {x₀ : P} {S : Finset (Cover x₀)} (hacyc : ∀ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V) (l : List (pieceQuiver S).A), l ≠ [] → ¬FinQuiver.PathFrom i l i) (le le' : List (pieceQuiver S).A) (i j : (pieceQuiver S).V) :
    FinQuiver.PathFrom i le j → FinQuiver.PathFrom i le' j → le ≠ le' → ∃ (p : List (pieceQuiver S).A) (i' : (pieceQuiver S).V) (e : (pieceQuiver S).A) (e' : (pieceQuiver S).A), FinQuiver.PathFrom i p i' ∧ (pieceQuiver S).src e = i' ∧ (pieceQuiver S).src e' = i' ∧ PR ((pieceQuiver S).tgt e) j ∧ PR ((pieceQuiver S).tgt e') j ∧ e ≠ e'
